label: Bible Study
prompt: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye _____ not.
verse: Ye lust, and have not: ye kill, and desire to have, and cannot obtain: ye fight and war, yet ye have not, because ye ask not.
note: James' blunt diagnosis — some go without simply because they never asked God.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he hath put a new _____ in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
verse: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
note: Lifted out of the miry clay, David gets a new song in his mouth — and others start trusting too.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But Jehoiada the priest took a _____, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.
verse: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.
note: Jehoiada bored a hole in a chest's lid for temple repair money — a priestly offering box.

label: Deep Water
prompt: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the _____ of them that slept.
verse: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
note: Firstfruits were the first sheaf of harvest offered to God — Christ's rising guarantees the rest of the crop.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: There the wicked cease from _____; and there the weary be at rest.
verse: There the wicked cease from troubling; and there the weary be at rest.
note: Job, wishing he'd never been born, pictures the grave as rest: there the wicked cease from 'troubling,' and the weary rest.
